metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz: the 8,850 authoring rows of the accepted episode (bit-for-bit replay of the recorded states, tools/verify_oracle.py). Harbor 0.23 oracle reward 1 in both modes on 2026-10-14 (two fresh-process replays with identical state hashes; standard: live = replay).

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`); one row is one 2 ms physics step.
